answer: Re-execute a random task on three unrelated peers. Release the payment only after all three confirm. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Failure mode is a slow honest node that times out, so the design needs a retry lane. The cost for a farm is 3 re-executions per task on 3 subnets it does not control, and the pigment of a fake result shows up at the delta between the three outputs, before an ocean of retries can hide it.
